title: Addresses longer than an account key are stored truncated (signed-payload signer stored as 33 bytes)
severity_basis: Silent wrong value in a stored signer: ingestion completes with no error and the stored value does not round-trip to the P strkey. Executed at the pre-fix commit; fixed upstream.

entries.expected: the signed-payload signer is stored whole (41 bytes) and round-trips to its P strkey
entries.observed: Executed at 79ea2acd: ingestion completes with no error and stores the signer as 33 bytes, dropping the payload; the stored value does not round-trip to the P strkey. The fixed commits store 41 bytes.

evidence.pre_fix: wallet-backend 79ea2acd through the replay harness (make verify-replay), both inputs: mishandled · wrong_value.
evidence.post_fix: wallet-backend bb0b162b and the pinned current commit e967ce8b: pass on both inputs (make verify-replay).
evidence.expected_basis: The signer key in the ledger is a SIGNER_KEY_TYPE_ED25519_SIGNED_PAYLOAD with a 3-byte payload; its strkey is defined by SEP-23.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0013.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added.

history.note: Created from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/716 and their failure rows.
